doc.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007

title: Touring overseas
summary: He has played Europe, South America, Australia and New Zealand and loves the audiences.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Do you get to travel around much overseas?
Yeah I’ve traveled in Europe. I haven’t really been to Asia yet but South America and Europe.
Did I see some photos of you in Australia?
Yeah. I was in — that’s true, I forgot about that. Australia and New Zealand last fall. That was a great experience too.

You know the road is wonderful. Everywhere I go on the road, I wish New York was like that, you know. No, I was totally in love with European audiences and Australia and New Zealand were wonderful, South America was wonderful, yeah.
